summary.para: The user who wrote a user-managed service account. If the request ran as another user, that user is recorded. If the request was made with an API key, the owner of the key is recorded, from the owner's own realm, together with the key itself. For an older API key that does not record its owner's realm, the realm is the API key realm, _es_api_key.
The API key that the request was made with. Absent when the request was not made with an API key, or when the API key ran as another user.
The name of the realm that authenticated the user.
The type of the realm that authenticated the user.
